title: Packed sequences and separate contexts
description: Terms for sharing token storage while preserving each example's attention, positions, targets and loss weight.

terms.definition: Placing complete input-target pair sequences into shared storage rows. Moving the pairs does not add cross-example targets or attention relationships.
One occurrence of a supplied example inside a packed row. Repeated uses of the same source range receive distinct occurrence segment IDs.
A real query may use only real keys from its own occurrence segment at local positions no later than the query. Inactive padding queries skip normalization.
Numbering prediction positions from zero within each occurrence, independently of its storage column in the packed row.
The immediate next source token in a selected example's input-target pair. EOS can be a valid target; a join between examples and a padding cell supply no target.
The raw loss summed over supervised real targets and divided once by their total count. Averaging unequal row or document means without count weights changes this objective.
